identity.name: Symbiosis Guard — Core Cleanliness & Health Sentinel

meta.description: Automated system for honeycomb health monitoring, deadline tracking, file quality validation, and structural cleanliness. Merged from ahimsa_filter, deadline_sentinel, and task_scanner under RM-013.

content.vision: Symbiosis Guard is the immune system of Mandala. It continuously monitors, validates, alerts, and heals.

components.ahimsa_filter: Detects duplicates, stale files, empty files, broken links, redundant fields, zero resonance, old backups
components.deadline_sentinel: Monitors task deadlines, sends auto-warnings, generates daily reports
components.task_scanner: Validates task_id uniqueness, JSON validity, required fields, non-standard statuses, expired deadlines
